name: clipsync
description: 복사 기록을 검색하고 재사용하며 텍스트·이미지·500MB 파일 클립보드를 기기 간 동기화하는 데스크톱 매니저

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac pkg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:cross: npm run build && node scripts/build-mac-apps.mjs && python3 scripts/build-macos-pkg.py
scripts.test:persistence: dbus-run-session -- bash scripts/test-with-keyring.sh node scripts/test-desktop.mjs tests/desktop.persistence.ts
